dose.definition: Magnitude of the first-higher-mode drop against the healthy recording of the same campaign, in percent. The fundamental (2.750 Hz) is unchanged in every state, so the damage is local, and the first-higher mode is the one that moves.

not_computed.ASC: no ASCENDING acquisition in both records, so no cosine is carried on that channel
not_computed.matrix: 2 x 2, of which only the post|rebuild cell carries a response
not_computed.middle: both assets have exactly two states, so there is no intermediate state to compare

H2.rules: descriptive: cosine of the two towers' standardised response vectors at the collapsed state — Haltern's post-collapse, KDLO's rebuild — each against its own pre-collapse reference; no magnitude is compared and the two assets share no orbit, date or atmosphere

reading.comparison_role: descriptive: the same metric applied to two assets, not a transferability test
